title: console routes address the same app by package id (/apps/com.example.showcase/…) and by app name (/apps/showcase_app/system/approvals)
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## Maintainer quick-read

The console addresses one app two ways: `/apps/com.example.showcase/…` (package id) for objects, pages and dashboards, and `/apps/showcase_app/system/approvals` (app name) after *View approvals*. Settle on one?

## Why it matters

Shared links, the recent-items list and `?id=` lookups key on one identifier while the address bar shows the other; RUNNER.md already records the package-id/app-name confusion as a recurring false-alarm source.

## Options

- **A** — app name everywhere, package-id paths redirect.
- **B** — package id everywhere, app-name paths redirect.
- **C** — status quo.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *console route app package id app name inconsistent url approvals*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *app URL segment uses package id in some links and app name in others, two paths for the same app*: 0 hits (0 open, 0 closed).
- No hit describes this defect.
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: console route app name package id mixed · apps url identifier inconsistent
